title: Latest-strip and stagger scale tests flake under full-suite load
body:
## Summary
latest.test.tsx and stagger.test.tsx fail intermittently in the full vitest run (a different module each time), never in isolation.

## Description
renderLayerAtScale waits for the layer, then settle(); the Latest strip and first-wave content can arrive after that under CPU load. Observed 2026-10-21: 3 of 9 full-suite runs red (spend small, tables large, rescue large), 0 of 5 console-dir runs red. Fixed looks like: the tests wait for the strip (or the tab count) before asserting.

## Flow
- run the full suite while another heavy process runs
- latest.test.tsx:38 reads strip() as null

## Expected impact
The integration gate stops reading red for no change. Risk: a wait that hides a real missing strip; keep the count==0 branch.

## Evaluation
Claim: quality - the full gate is deterministic
Before: 3/9 full runs red
After: unmeasured
Method: simulation - flake rate needs repeated full runs under load
Result: better
Gate: none
instrument: run latest.test + stagger.test 10x under a parallel CPU load (vitest --pool forks with the full suite); count reds before/after
